name: Kopia Workspace Backups
short_desc: Encrypted Coder workspace backups with Kopia and rclone
author: Kopia
description: Kopia web UI for encrypted, deduplicated backups of Coder workspace home and source data to remote storage, including rclone remotes.

form_fields.label: Kopia web UI password
form_fields.hint: Log in as kopia. At least 12 characters; avoid dollar signs (Compose interpolation). Use HTTPS when exposed.

form_fields.label: Repository encryption password
form_fields.hint: Use this same password when creating or connecting the repository. Back it up separately: losing it makes recovery impossible. Changing this field does not rotate the repository password.
